description: Source script for generating target configuration and profile makefiles based on target metadata. Contains functions for parsing target features, name, kernel version, and generating configuration blocks for build systems.

methods.name: target_config_features
methods.description: Generates configuration flags based on target features list.

methods.name: target_name
methods.description: Returns formatted target name with parent if available.

methods.name: kver
methods.description: Converts version string to a standardized format suitable for configuration symbols.

methods.name: print_target
methods.description: Prints configuration blocks for a given target, including features and dependencies.

methods.name: merge_package_lists
methods.description: Merges two lists of packages, avoiding duplicates and handling removals.

methods.name: gen_target_config
methods.description: Main function to generate complete target configuration files based on metadata.

methods.name: gen_profile_mk
methods.description: Generates profile-specific makefiles from target metadata.

methods.name: parse_command
methods.description: Dispatches command line arguments to appropriate functions for generation.
